_note: Tuning knobs for kgb/map. Every value is optional and type-checked — missing or invalid entries fall back to built-in defaults, so this file can never break the map. Coordinates are [lng, lat].

mask._note: Focus the map on campus. dimOutside fades the outside world 0-1 (0 = off) using dimColor; boundaryFill tints the campus interior (0 = off); restrictPanning keeps the camera near campus (panBuffer in degrees). NOTE: hiding outside 3D buildings via a within-filter is NOT possible — MapLibre within() only evaluates Point/LineString features, building polygons always return false.

detail._note: High-contrast overlays on the bright base (paths are faint #cba there, pitches/parking unstyled). All read from the same openmaptiles planet source.
